---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

This page compares the budgets and revenues of the films through scatterplot. In @fig-budget-revenue, scatterplot shows whether budget size results in increased revenue size.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Relationship between budget and revenue for movies in dataset"

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget")
plt.ylabel("Revenue")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()
```
